All applicants/nominee completing this form should apply to the Director, Criminal Investigation
Department (CID) for a police Report.
The Police Report should be submitted under the seal of the Director of CID to the
following address:
The Commissioner of Insurance
National Insurance Commission
Appiah Ampofo House
Independence Avenue
P. O. Box CT 3456
Cantonments, Accra
